VULNERABILITY: The JWT uses "alg": "none" which means NO SIGNATURE VERIFICATION.
The token ends with a period (.) with no signature component.

This allows an attacker to:
1. Forge tokens by modifying claims (role, user ID, email)
2. Impersonate any user including administrators
3. Access unauthorized resources
